errors.text: The proposed L12 order-parameter threshold of approximately 0.8 and APBE threshold above 100 mJ/m² are unsupported quantitative inventions rather than established critical boundaries.
The claim that reduced nanoindentation pile-up indicates planar slip is questionable; restricted cross-slip and planar slip can instead produce localized slip bands and dislocation pile-ups.
The cited evidence does not directly validate the claimed APBE, SISFE/SFE modulation, jagged-interface mechanism, or the numerical transition thresholds in this alloy.
